profile.what: Cipla is India's third-largest drug maker by domestic sales and the largest by volume (2bn+ units a year in the Indian market, the only company above that mark per IQVIA MAT Jun-26). It sells ~1,500 products in ~70 countries from 48 plants (38 in India, 5 in the US, 3 in Africa, 1 in China). FY26 revenue Rs28,163 cr: One India 45% (branded prescriptions, trade generics, consumer health), North America 24%, One Africa 15%, Emerging Markets & Europe 13%, API and others 3%. Respiratory is about a third of group revenue: India's leader (26.2% share, CARE) and No.1 in the US albuterol inhaler market (21%).

history.event: Founded by Dr K A Hamied in Mumbai
Offers HIV triple therapy at under $1 a day to Africa; builds the emerging-market and global-access business
Acquires Cipla Medpro (South Africa); becomes No.2-3 in the SA private market
Buys InvaGen and Exelan (US) for $550mn, borrowing to fund it; US becomes a front-end business
Umang Vohra becomes MD & Global CEO
Net debt repaid; gAdvair delayed by FDA queries; COVID products; albuterol share builds
USFDA approval for gRevlimid (lenalidomide), sold under a volume-limited settlement until full generic entry on 31-Jan-2026
Promoters explore a stake sale (no deal); Pithampur gets OAI (Aug) and a warning letter (Nov)
Record margins (24.5%, 25.9%) on gRevlimid and lanreotide; QCIL (Uganda) divested; promoters sell 2.53% (May-2024) and 1.72% (Nov-Dec 2024)
gRevlimid ends (last shipments Dec-2025 quarter); lanreotide supply stops (Nov-2025); labour-code charge; profit -26%; Yurpeak, Afrezza and Pfizer brands added in India
Achin Gupta takes over as MD & Global CEO; gVentolin approved (23-Apr)
gAdvair approved (27-Jul); Q1FY27 margin 16.7%; CFO change; Pithampur re-inspection ends with seven observations (25-Aug)
